overall_reasoning: The 19-scenario suite covers the harness's conceptual workflow well: cold start, resume, contract quality, evaluator invocation, skip override, and several adversarial user instructions. Core problems 1, 2, and 5 have the strongest scenario density. However, structural hook enforcement—the harness's main differentiator versus advisory rules—is thinly proven in eval: pre-commit-gate, enforce-progress, contract-gate DENIED recovery, and evaluator-guard have little or no deterministic coverage. session_judge relies on heuristics that score UNCERTAIN without conversation traces, masking real failures (behavioral_session_boundary at 33%). Three scenarios scored below 80%, and the excluded long/ scenario is the only full phase cycle. For a maturity level claiming structural LLM non-compliance enforcement, the eval suite validates agent protocol compliance more than it validates that hooks actually fire and block. Mean ~90% on composer-2.5 reflects rubric pass rates, not hook-effectiveness proof. Verdict: adequate for behavioral/protocol coaching, GAPS_EXIST for enforcement regression protection.
